paper_interpretation: Conservative alternative. Strongest network evidence and strongest feature-holdout robustness, with good temporal persistence, but fewer behavioural roles.
Main descriptive taxonomy. Best seed stability and richer role vocabulary, but weaker network same-role evidence than K4/K6 and weaker feature-holdout recovery than K4.
Fine-grained alternative. Network evidence is strong and activity holdout recovery is good, but seed stability is weakest and one role is fragile under a volatility/concentration holdout.
